entry.text: Two-fifty-nine. He'd been dead for years. Somebody else's years.

terminate.text: He looked into the kiosk camera — into us — and pressed it. The hour was nearly full.

hotspots.label: velvet ropes
hotspots.examine: A queue system for a hall that hasn't seen a human teller since the twenties. The ropes remain. Ropes are patient.

hotspots.label: poster
hotspots.examine: 'YOUR MONEY, SMARTER.' The poster's man smiles at a graph. The graph is of the poster's man's smile.

hotspots.label: clock
hotspots.examine: 02:59. Sixty-one seconds left in the hour of refunds.

hotspots.label: doors
hotspots.examine: Locked until 09:00. The kiosk never sleeps. Neither, apparently, do I.

hotspots.label: kiosk
hotspots.examine: It knows me. Thirty percent of me, anyway. The wrong thirty percent.

start.text: Welcome! Identity check… VIKTOR K. — MATCH CONFIDENCE: 70%. Advisory: 30% match with a deceased account holder carrying outstanding obligations and a criminal record. Available services: viewing this message.

choices.t: I've banked here for six years.

dead.text: UNDERSTOOD. To dispute, please provide proof of life in person at any staffed branch. Staffed branches within 500km: 0.

loyal.text: LOYALTY CONFIRMED. Note: deceased customers are among our most loyal. They rarely switch providers.

confirm.text: Closing this account will not affect your outstanding obligations (they belong to someone else, who is you). Your 6 years of loyalty will be transferred to: no one. Proceed?

end.line: 02:59. The last one we watch. Then the counter spins — and somewhere, a dashboard draws a line half a centimeter down.
